The Figure Skater With Amenorrhea

Emily, a 16-year-old student in a highly competitive figure skating program,
was sent to me by her coach. Emily’s mother made the appointment for
her. Because she was chronically tired, Emily's ability to jump high and skate
hard was compromised. Emily's first words to me were, “My coach and
mother made me come here. They think | don’t eat enough.”
